trend_method: Current cycle: Bayesian poll aggregate (a smooth, damped trend from the previous result, adjusting for each pollster's house effect and sample size; bands are 90% credible intervals; 2PP implied from primaries via estimated preference flows). Earlier cycles: simple 60-day kernel average of published polls.

Ashton Hurn replaces Vincent Tarzia as Liberal leader and leader of the opposition
